updates.title: Land Clearing Completed on Odienné Farm
updates.excerpt: AfriNuts completes land preparation on its 50-hectare cashew plantation in Odienné, Ivory Coast.
updates.content: The land clearing phase marks a significant milestone in our farm development project. Over 50 hectares have been prepared using sustainable methods that preserve topsoil and local biodiversity. The next phase will involve planting drought-resistant cashew varieties in Q3 2024.
updates.author: Hamza S. Ralsan Sangare

updates.title: Partnership with Local Farmers Cooperative
updates.excerpt: AfriNuts signs agreement with Odienné Cashew Growers Association to support 200 smallholder farmers.
updates.content: This partnership will provide training on sustainable farming techniques and guaranteed purchase agreements for members' raw cashews. The program aims to increase yields by 30% while maintaining organic certification standards across the region.
updates.author: Sekou Hakim Petter
